summary: Checked all 34 estimates against the saved 58-page September 22, 2023 working paper. Read the full markdown including Appendices A-E, extracted every cited PDF page, and inspected the raster recommendation-quality rubric. All 187 source quotes match their cited PDF pages. All recorded numeric statistics and counts were confirmed; the 27 table-based estimates match the correct columns and arms in Tables 1, 4, and 6. The 385-person inside-frontier sample, 373-person correctness sample, and 372-person recommendation-quality model sample are distinguished correctly; unprinted two-arm counts remain null. The reported percentage gains, question-level mean effects, and control-minus-AI decrease retain their printed units and direction. The other requested outcome and design codes are supported, including convergent correctness under extraction rule 6 and participant-level between-person semantic similarity under Appendix D. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found missing under rules 4-6; excluded subgroup, model-only, productivity, and figure-only results are documented. Two metadata issues remain on the qualitative idea-list creativity record: the unidentifiable measure flagged by the script and the combined-arm label.
